_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Check a sitemap sample for broken links...

description: Finds broken or redirected pages in a sitemap sample. Use it when the user asks whether pages of an online store or website are broken or redirected, or for a broken link in the sitemap, for example "are any pages of shop.example.com broken?", "check my sitemap for 404s" or "do my product pages redirect?". Pass the domain. Reads the sitemap (for a sitemap index, the product, page, collection and blog sitemaps first) and checks up to 40 addresses spread across it, on that host only, returning counts by status, and for each broken, unreachable or redirected address its status and final address. It is a sample, not every page; it uses HEAD requests at low concurrency, skips addresses that robots.txt disallows for Agent Tools, and makes at most 46 requests. Do not use it for private or local addresses, to read page content, or to monitor a site over time.

domain.description: Host name of a public store or website, for example shop.example.com. If you only have a page address, pass it: only its host is used.

name: link_sample_check

failure.description: Why the site or page was not reached or read, such as a timeout or a robots.txt disallow for Agent Tools.

notes.description: Plain-language caveats to pass on with the result.

notice.description: As-of caveat: what the site sent to Agent Tools at that moment, not what every agent sees.

origin.description: Origin the sitemap was read from, after redirects.

reachable.description: False when the site did not answer; failure then says why.

status.description: found: rules were read. missing: a 4xx answer, so nothing is restricted. unreachable: a 5xx or no answer, so no other file or page was requested.

found.description: False when no sitemap was found, so nothing was sampled.

kind.description: index for a sitemap index, otherwise urlset.

truncated.description: True when the sitemap was too large to read in full.

urlsListed.description: Addresses listed in the sitemaps read.

source.description: Where the data came from: the website itself.

statuses.description: Count of sampled addresses for each HTTP status code.

summary.description: Counts for the sample of up to 40 addresses.

title: Check a sitemap sample for broken links
